Noxe Pixel Engine — adapted pixel rendering
https://github.com/danieljan-design/noxe-pixel-engine
Upstream: engine/shaders.js (Bayer 4x4, levels quantisation, nearest pixel upscale).
Copyright (c) 2026 Daniel Jankulovski. MIT license included in LICENSE.
Retrieved 2026-11-10.
Antaris adaptation: src/pixel-look.ts. Uses existing Three.js colour management,
perspective camera and materials. Omits upstream MRT normals, outline, bloom,
procedural sky, audio, weather and camera snapping. This is a subset of the effect,
not the full engine or an exact reproduction of the authored scenes.
